description:
If you want to make the ULTIMATE Nutella ice cream, this is the recipe for you. This is not a "no churn" or "quick and easy" Nutella recipe, this is a Super Premium Nutella Ice Cream recipe that rivals all the major brands. 

The Ice Cream Base:
300ml cream
250ml Milk
65g Nutella 
75g Sugar
50g Cocoa powder
1/2 tsp vanilla
Pinch of salt

Brownie Bites:
Frozen and Crushed Brownies 100g
2 TBSP Nutella
Chocolate Mould

Marshmallow Cream:
2 large egg whites
100g granulated sugar
1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar
1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla extract (optional)


You can freeze this overnight of you want (if you can wait that long) or just a few hours. The result is something similar to Ben & Jerry's Phish Food but all about Nutella :)

I’ve never made ice cream before, but had been looking into making some the past few weeks. The more I looked up recipes, the more overwhelmed I was… until I came across your videos… THANK YOU!! 

You are very informative, I find it so educational and really appreciate the time and effort you must go to in order to bring us this content. I especially appreciate the break down of the science, eg. The explanation on stabilisers! 

I have some questions, some might be silly or naive, but I’m curious just the same. When you write a recipe and use a TSP, TBSP or cup measurement, for example, what system are you using? (Metric, US/US Imperial & Imperial, etc). 
I’m in Australia and our cup and spoon measurements are different from the US. 
For example an Australian cup = 250ml and the US cup = 240ml. 
Are you in Canada? You use Celsius and millilitres, metric like us Aussies. Would it be safe to assume your spoon measurements are also metric? Or do you use US spoon measurements in your recipes? 
Also, I haven’t been able to find corn syrup or dextrose in my town, what alternatives could you recommend? And one last question 😅 can you replace the cocoa powder with something else if you don’t have cocoa powder? 

I’m so sorry for the novel! Thank you so much for your time and all your amazing recipes and videos!
